body: Refreshed with main (5bdfc00c) via its refreshed parent #951 (3f490c97): merging #951 brought main in and was clean - the `doosan-dnm.cps` guard conflict was resolved on #951 (main's `chainCut()` guard, then the rotary feed word); this PR's own A-state change merged on top without a conflict. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` stays main's 18. Tests, all green: doosan_dnm_post 7, doosan_dnm_a_state 2, rotary_feed_cap 5, fourth_axis_pose 9, conformance 6, post_unit_word 5, per_op_files 9, comment_escape 3, suppressed_rest 2, fanuc_post 11, drill_prior 12, drill_rplane 8. `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-fail-fast` green except `script_tormach_plasma`, which fails identically on main 5bdfc00c (stale plasma refusal goldens). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` and app clippy on the two touched suites clean. Mergeable: MERGEABLE. Ready for a re-check.
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).

Back to draft (M5): my quick pass readied this by mistake. The body says it waits on a Hub run before going ready (it changes posted G-code for rotary programs). It goes ready again once that run is recorded.

Refreshed for the merge batch. Merged #951's current head (bc5e9b00, which contains the 8054397b unit fix) and then origin/main (PROCESS_VERSION 54, main's value) into this branch; both merges were clean, no hand resolution. One test fixture fix on top (commit e091d782): the two `doosan_dnm_a_state` streams had no spindle speed, so main's `spindleStopped()` refusal (kept first in doosan-dnm.cps and fanuc.cps) now refused their feeds; they now state `PARAM SpindleSpeed 6000`. The refusal and #951's `rotaryFeedWord(..., inch)` (unit from `postOptions.Units`) are untouched.

Gate, all green: doosan_dnm_a_state 2, rotary_feed_cap 9, fourth_axis_pose 9, c_axis_unwind 7, post_unit_word 5, program_units 7, `cargo test -p camcraft-post` all suites, clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings clean. Diff against main lists only the files of #951 and #952. Still a draft waiting on the Hub run named in the body. New head e091d782. Ready for a review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e091d782c4abc50cc2b539b3d97b6babcda4245d -->
**Needs no changes from this review; the Hub hold stands (this PR stays a draft).** Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge once the Hub run is in. This review did not flag it ready.

Scope: judged #952's own change on top of #951; the #951 part (rotary feed cap, bc5e9b00) is carried unchanged (diff from bc5e9b00 to head touches only doosan-dnm.cps at 3 lines, the two test files, decisions, and main's own AGENTS.md / PROCESS_VERSION / #688 decision). Trial merge with current origin/main: already up to date, no conflicts.

**What looks good**
- `lastA/lastB/lastC` start as `null` and reset to `null` (not 0) at tool change and section end (doosan-dnm.cps:69, 595, 693). Every comparison already goes through `has(lastA)` or `!==`, so null means "write the A word" (lines 366, 390-392, 738, 786, 805). No new path where an unknown angle is read as a number.
- Main's `spindleStopped()` refusal stays first: in onLinear it runs right after the chain check and before the feed word (doosan-dnm.cps:789), arcs at 808, cycles at 890. Unchanged.
- Unit unchanged: no unit code touched; #951's `postOptions.Units` handling is carried as is (post_unit_word and program_units pass).
- No golden, snapshot, Cargo, build.rs, .github or script change. Decision file 950-dnm-a-state.md present, provenance line on the new test.

**Which programs post differently** (doosan-dnm.cps, programs with an A word only; 3-axis programs never write A and are unaffected)
1. The first A of a program and of each section/tool change is now written even when it is A0, with the M11/M10 brake pair around it (it was skipped on the assumed A0). Fixes the A0-after-A30 case that cut at A30.
2. With TCP (G43.4) the turn back to A0 after A30 now unclamps (M11/M10); before it did not.
3. Refused before, passes now: #951's "a feed that turns A from an angle the post does not know" refusal for a plain 4th axis whose stream opens at A0. The opening rapid now writes A0, so the control's A is placed and the stated A rate is held (test rewritten to assert the A0 word and 5 rate-checked moves). That is a legitimate lift, not a hole: the angle is known because the post wrote it. The still-unplaced case (no A word before the feed) remains covered by the other asserts in that test.

**Refresh agent's test edit (`PARAM SpindleSpeed 6000`)**: correct. It is in the two new doosan_dnm_a_state streams only, each stream states a spindle speed before its first feed, exactly as a real program does. It does not hide a refusal case: those tests assert A words and brake order, not the spindle refusal, which main's own tests pin separately.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| doosan_dnm_a_state | 2 passed |
| rotary_feed_cap | 9 passed |
| fourth_axis_pose | 9 passed |
| c_axis_unwind | 7 passed |
| post_unit_word | 5 passed |
| program_units | 7 passed |
| camcraft-post (all) | all green |
| clippy post + app, all-targets, -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Costs one extra A block (plus brake pair) per section where the angle already matches; the decision file records this trade-off.
- Hub run still required before ready (per the PR body); not run here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Moved to #1396 (same commits plus merges of #1395's branch and main, branch in this repository, stacked on #1395) on the maintainer's order; work and review continue there.
